snippet.title: Last Watchtower - Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Last Watchtower is a short incremental defense game. Gather resources, pick upgrades, and unlock powerful tower abilities. Experiment with diverse builds, withstand relentless monster waves, and grow stronger with every run through permanent meta-progression.

PLAY THE DEMO:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4026370/Last_Watchtower/

Music
Clockwork by JHawk
https://jhawk-studios.itch.io/dungeon-music-pack
